title: More Assistance for Low-wage and Elderly Jobseekers and for Students Majoring in Aerospace, Aviation and Hospitality
what_it_is: More Assistance for Low-wage and Elderly Jobseekers and for Students Majoring in Aerospace, Aviation and Hospitality

sections.label: Jobs and skills opportunities
sections.summary: The National Jobs Council curated about 117,500 jobs and skills opportunities under the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package for local jobseekers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower in view of the slowdown in the aviation sector, how will the Ministry help students majoring in aerospace, aviation and hospitality who are graduating in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sharael Taha
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower by the end of the Job Redesign Grant in March 2020 (a) what is the total number of applications received and how many jobs have been successfully redesigned for elderly workers; and (b) what are the lessons learnt that have been incorporated into the Job Growth Incentive to increase the participation of companies to redesign jobs for the elderly.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Through the National Jobs Council, we have curated about 117,500 jobs and skills opportunities under the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package to help local jobseekers acquire new skills to move into new careers or sectors.

sections.label: Job Redesign Grant outcomes
sections.summary: From July 2016 to March 2020, the JRG benefited over 2,500 companies and 24,000 senior workers.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: From scheme enhancement in July 2016 to grant closure in March 2020, the JRG benefited over 2,500 companies and 24,000 senior workers.

sections.label: Government salary underwriting
sections.summary: The Government will underwrite 50% of salaries, up to the first $5,000, for 12 months.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The Government will underwrite 50% of their salaries, up to the first $5,000, for 12 months.

sections.label: Employers accept varied disciplines
sections.summary: Employers are generally open to accepting good candidates across a range of disciplines.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In general, employers are open to accepting good candidates across a range of disciplines.

sections.label: Local employment rebound
sections.summary: Advance estimates for the third quarter show a rebound in local employment, with pockets of businesses recovering and hiring.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Advance estimates for the third quarter show a rebound in local employment.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Pockets of businesses are recovering and hiring, and we will make every effort to help affected Singaporeans get back to work.

sections.label: Job redesign for seniors
sections.summary: With 16.8% of the population above 65, the question asks about nudging companies to redesign jobs and including job redesign for seniors in the Industry Transformation Map.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sharael Taha (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: At present, with 16.8% of population above the age of 65, what more can we do to nudge companies to proactively redesign jobs to ensure gainful employment for our ageing population.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sharael Taha (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: And also, can both MOM and MTI consider including job redesign for seniors, including work-from-home, job-sharing, micro jobs as one of the key elements in the Industry Transformation Map.

sections.label: Ability and Productivity Solutions Grant
sections.summary: The issue is ability to do so, which is why an additional element was added under the Productivity Solutions Grant.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The issue is not so much willingness; the issue is much more about the ability to do so, which is why under the Productivity Solutions Grant, we decided to add in an additional element.

sections.label: Senior workers pay and re-employment
sections.summary: Higher pay for senior workers can create difficulty in continued employment, which is why the Re-employment Age complements the Retirement Age.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: But it can also work against him later on when the companies then look at the entire workforce and find that, perhaps, compared to their younger colleagues, the senior workers are much more highly paid and, if they do not make a concerted effort to work with the unions to restructure the salary accordingly, then, later on, when it comes to continued employment, that actually could be a difficulty.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: It is also why, instead of just raising the statutory minimum Retirement Age, we have chosen to complement it with the Re-employment Age because, in re-employment, you can get a person to stay in work but not necessarily in the same job and not necessarily at the same pay.

sections.label: Older PCP participant and ageism
sections.summary: The oldest PCP participant encountered was about 67, and employers recognise the value of hiring experienced people, though seniors have concerns about ageism.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The oldest participant in a PCP programme that I have encountered, if my memory serves me right, was something like 67 years old.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: So, more and more, we also find that employers recognise that if they are open to hiring people who bring with them very rich experiences, then, in fact, they serve as a mentor to the younger colleagues in the organisation and they actually work well together.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: But having said that, I do recognise that seniors have concerns about ageism.

sections.label: Aerospace Engineering internships secured
sections.summary: About half of the current Aerospace Engineering cohort needing internships secured internships related to their discipline of study.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If we take Aerospace Engineering, for example, for the current cohort that need to go for internships, about half have still been able to secure internships that are related to their discipline of study, meaning that they are interning in roles that are related to Aerospace Engineering.

sections.label: Agencies secure internships in manufacturing
sections.summary: With combined efforts of different agencies, all students secured internship positions, not all in Aerospace Engineering but meaningful for experience.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In manufacturing. for example, there is great value in applying the disciplines of Aerospace Engineering.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: So, with the combined efforts of different agencies coming together, in fact, all of them have been able to secure internship positions, not all of them in Aerospace Engineering but, in the other areas, it is also very meaningful way for them to acquire experience before they graduate.

sections.label: Collective efforts and SGUnited Traineeships
sections.summary: Collective agency efforts and students' willingness to step out of their comfort zone secured meaningful internships, and SGUnited Traineeship Programmes may continue if jobs remain in short supply.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: So, that gives us a sense as to how the collective efforts of the agencies involved, together with the students' own willingness to step out of their comfort zone, they have been able to secure meaningful internships which, we believe, will enable them to be better positioned for the job market.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: And if jobs continue to be in short supply for such students then, certainly, we will look at how the SGUnited Traineeship Programmes can be continued.
